mapper.select: WITH bounds AS ( SELECT ST_TileEnvelope(#{z}, #{x}, #{y}) AS geom ), mvtgeom AS ( SELECT id, name, height, ST_AsMVTGeom( ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(t.geom, 4326), 3857), (SELECT geom FROM bounds), 4096, 64, true ) AS geom FROM ${table} t WHERE ST_Intersects( ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(t.geom, 4326), 3857), (SELECT geom FROM bounds) ) ) SELECT ST_AsMVT(mvtgeom.*, '${table}', 4096, 'geom') FROM mvtgeom WHERE geom IS NOT NULL
